Music production: write code, refine with verbs and effects, add punch with sidechain, export audio or MIDI.

nodes.label: LOOM Language
nodes.description: A live-coding music language with an AI brain that runs in browser, phone, and terminal. Designed for musicians/composers learning to code.

nodes.label: loom-core (Rust)
nodes.description: Zero-dependency Rust crate containing the parser, verbs, and per-bar scheduler. Fully tested and serves as the single source of truth for the language logic.

nodes.label: loom-wasm (WASM)
nodes.description: wasm-bindgen wrapper around loom-core for browser and phone execution.

nodes.label: loom-tui (Terminal)
nodes.description: Terminal client skeleton using native audio and terminal grid UI (ratatui).

nodes.label: Web Prototype (JavaScript)
nodes.description: Browser-based LOOM with JavaScript engine (web/index.html). Playground for testing language features before porting to Rust.

nodes.label: AI Brain
nodes.description: Strongest available Claude model (Fable/Opus) that generates valid LOOM code from plain-language music descriptions. Authenticated via Max subscription, not API key.

nodes.label: night-build Branch
nodes.description: Git branch containing 17 commits of feature development with all cargo tests passing (42 tests green), safe to review and merge.

nodes.label: Pattern Syntax
nodes.description: Core syntax rule: name: pattern | verb | verb. One voice per line, patterns fill one bar evenly.

nodes.label: Drums (Percussion)
nodes.description: Four reserved drum names: kick, snare, hat, clap. Use 'x' for hit and '.' for rest.

nodes.label: Melody (Notes)
nodes.description: Any voice name other than drums plays melodic notes using note names (c3, eb2, g4) or scale degrees (1-7).

nodes.label: Scale Degrees (1-7)
nodes.description: Melodic voices can use degrees 1-7 instead of absolute notes. Degrees resolve against the declared key and scale.

nodes.label: Verbs (Transformations)
nodes.description: Pattern transformations applied after | : rev, fast, slow, every, jux, chunk, off, add, palindrome, mutate, etc.

nodes.label: Key & Tonality
nodes.description: Declare tonality with 'key: c minor' or similar. Establishes the root and scale for scale degrees and chords.

nodes.label: World Gammes (28+)
nodes.description: 28+ scales including Western modes, world traditions (maqam, raga, gamelan), blues, harmonic/melodic minor, whole-tone, chromatic, and microtonals.

nodes.label: Maqam (Arabic Music)
nodes.description: Arabic music scales with quarter-tones. Approximated in 12-TET; full microtonal layer planned.

nodes.label: Raga (Indian Music)
nodes.description: Indian classical scale system. Supported as a gamme option.

nodes.label: Gamelan (Indonesian Music)
nodes.description: Indonesian ensemble music scales (slendro, pelog). Supported as gamme options.

nodes.label: Chords (Accords)
nodes.description: 30+ chord qualities (maj, m, dim, aug, 7, maj7, m7, sus, add9, etc.). MAJUSCULE token = chord, minuscule = single note.

nodes.label: Roman Numeral Chords
nodes.description: Diatonic chords using I ii iii IV V vi vii (+7 for seventh). Qualities adapt to the scale.

nodes.label: Arpeggios
nodes.description: Spreads chord notes over the beat duration using | arp up/down/updown/downup/converge/diverge/thumb/pinky.

nodes.label: Euclidean Rhythms
nodes.description: Distributes k hits evenly over n steps using Bjorklund algorithm. Notation: e(k,n) or e(k,n,rot).

nodes.label: Probabilistic Notes
nodes.description: Tokens play conditionally: x? (~50%), x?70 (70%), c3?25. Applies to any token type.

nodes.label: Seed (Reproducible Randomness)
nodes.description: seed: N makes random choices reproducible. RNG: SplitMix64/(seed,bar,voice,step). Change seed for variation.

nodes.label: Ratchets & Rolls
nodes.description: x*N fires N rapid hits in one step. Combinable with probability: x*4?60. Fills and buildups.

nodes.label: Cellular Automata
nodes.description: Wolfram CA generators: ca(rule,n). Rules 90, 30, 110, 18, 150 evolve rhythm each measure.

nodes.label: Thue-Morse & Fibonacci
nodes.description: Self-similar sequence generators: morse(n), fib(n). Mathematical rhythm patterns.

nodes.label: Markov Chains
nodes.description: Regenerates melody from its own note-to-note transitions. | markov verb.

nodes.label: Waveforms
nodes.description: Basic oscillator shapes: saw, sine, tri, pulse, square.

nodes.label: FM Synthesis
nodes.description: Frequency modulation: | fm RATIO INDEX. Bell sounds, e-piano, thick basses (index 1-6).

nodes.label: Wavetable Synthesis
nodes.description: Timbral variety: | wt organ/warm/rich/soft. Wavetable interpolation.

nodes.label: Additive Synthesis
nodes.description: Harmonic content control: | partials A B C. Specify amplitude of each partial.

nodes.label: Super-Saw (Unison)
nodes.description: Multiple detuned oscillators: | unison N | detune C | spread N. Thick, fat sound.

nodes.label: Hard-Sync Oscillators
nodes.description: Oscillator sync for sweeping leads: | sync N. Classic rave/acid sound.

nodes.label: Physical Modeling
nodes.description: Instrument models: pluck (Karplus-Strong), bow, reed, bell (modal). Acoustic textures.

nodes.label: Granular Synthesis
nodes.description: Micro-grain clouds: | grain N. Texture and ambient sounds.

nodes.label: Filters (LP/HP/BP/Notch)
nodes.description: Frequency filtering: | lp N, | hp N, | bp N, | notch N. Optional resonance: q R.

nodes.label: Envelope (ADSR)
nodes.description: Amplitude envelope: | env A D S R. Attack, decay, sustain level, release in seconds.

nodes.label: LFO (Low Frequency Oscillator)
nodes.description: Modulation LFO: | lfo cutoff|pitch|gain|pan RATE DEPTH [form]. Wobble, vibrato, tremolo, autopan.

nodes.label: Sidechain / Ducking (Pump)
nodes.description: Global ducking directive: duck: N. Master gains pump at each kick hit. Techno/house pump effect.

nodes.label: Reverb & Delay
nodes.description: Spatial effects: | reverb N, | delay N (send levels 0-1). Echo sync: | echo DIV [FB].

nodes.label: Convolution Reverb (IR)
nodes.description: Real acoustic spaces: | ir hall|room|plate|spring|cathedral [mix]. Insert per-voice.

nodes.label: Distortion & Drive
nodes.description: Nonlinear saturation: | drive X (0-1). Warmth and grit.

nodes.label: Bitcrush
nodes.description: Digital degradation: | crush BITS (1-8). Lo-fi and IDM textures.

nodes.label: Chorus & Phaser
nodes.description: Widening and sweeping: | chorus N, | phaser N. Psychoacoustic effects.

nodes.label: Song Structure
nodes.description: Arrangement syntax: song: intro*4 verse*8 chorus*8… (name*bars, loops). Enables long-form pieces.

nodes.label: Section Tagging
nodes.description: Voices tagged with | in verse chorus only play in those sections. Drives/drops by adding/removing layers.

nodes.label: Variation A/B/C
nodes.description: Token <a/b/c> chooses one alternative per measure (cycles). Evolving patterns.

nodes.label: Tempo & Meter
nodes.description: bpm: 128, meter: 7/8, accel: 120 160. Tempo and time signature with accelerando/ritardando.

nodes.label: WAV Export (Audio Recording)
nodes.description: REC button: captures stereo 16-bit WAV output. RENDER: bounces entire piece to WAV.

nodes.label: MIDI Out
nodes.description: | midi CH sends voice to DAW/synth hardware. Drums → GM channel 10. Playable in any DAW.

nodes.label: URL Sharing
nodes.description: Share button: copies link (code encoded in URL). Play and edit shared pieces instantly.

nodes.label: Video Export (FILM)
nodes.description: Exports video (format: vertical/square/wide). Title card, music synced to visuals.

nodes.label: Visual Scenes (95+)
nodes.description: 95 built-in visualizers: radial, tunnel, starfield, kaleido, aurora, julia, plasma, mandelbrot, lorenz, etc. Canvas2D + 4 GPU shaders.

nodes.label: Terminal Themes
nodes.description: 6 visual themes: CRT (green), AMBER, C64, DOS, APPLE II, MODERN. Selectable row, localStorage saved.

nodes.label: Voice Visualization (viz & hue)
nodes.description: Per-voice visuals: | viz burst|ring|beam|flash|shape and | hue N (color). Drives the scene.

nodes.label: Drum Samples
nodes.description: Pre-loaded samples: bd, sd, hh, cp, kick2, kick909, clubkick, clap2, oh, rim, cow, perc, tom, tom2, tom3, ride, tabla.

nodes.label: Melodic Samples (Repitched)
nodes.description: Samples pitched to scale degrees: bass, arpy, gtr, casio, sax, sitar, juno, hoover, stab, bleep, sid, voodoo.

nodes.label: Loop & Voice Samples
nodes.description: Loops (amen, break, amencut) and vocal/texture (vox, yeah, breath, wood, metal, glass, bottle).

nodes.label: DAW Mode (Studio)
nodes.description: Visual mixer, bus/sends, LUFS metering, mastering EQ, sampler instrument with time-stretch, timeline arrangement.

nodes.label: Knowledge Base & Philosophy
nodes.description: Integrated explanations of each scale, tradition, and concept (rasa, ethos, wuxing, consonance). University in the app.

nodes.label: Motivic Development & Form
nodes.description: Formal composition tools: inversion, retrograde, augmentation/diminution, tension curves, arches, moment-form.
